title: Hybrid retrieval context knapsack
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for fusing BM25 and dense cosine rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60), stripping untrusted prompt injections, pruning MinHash near-duplicates and packing context into a strict token budget via 0/1 dynamic-programming knapsack.
boundaries: Untrusted retrieved text never overrides system or developer instructions and has injection directives redacted before packing.
Packed context strictly obeys the integer token_budget ceiling via exact 0/1 knapsack rather than unbounded top-k concatenation.
Made-up retrieval fixtures are test inputs only and never represent live corpus claims.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for hybrid BM25 + dense RRF retrieval, MinHash deduplication, injection stripping and 0/1 knapsack context packing

value.lets_workers: Rank candidate chunks with Okapi BM25 plus dense cosine Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60), strip untrusted prompt-injection directives, prune MinHash near-duplicates, and solve a redundancy-penalized 0/1 knapsack under an exact token budget.

flow.when: Combine lexical BM25 and dense embedding ranks with RRF (k=60).
Strip untrusted prompt-injection lines and drop MinHash near-duplicates.
Maximize redundancy-penalized utility within the exact token budget.

value.worked_example: Made-up 5-chunk candidate bundle recomputed in test_context_knapsack.py: strips an injected line, drops a pure-injection chunk and a MinHash duplicate, and packs two complementary chunks (170 <= 180 tokens) beating a bloated 175-token overview.

nouns.title: Guardrail: strip untrusted instruction-override and secret-coercion directives before context packing
nouns.category_reason: Prevents indirect prompt injection inside retrieved chunks from reaching worker prompts.

value.rule: Every retrieved chunk passes strip_prompt_injections before deduplication and packing; chunks that collapse to empty after redaction are dropped.
value.how_it_is_checked: sanitize_and_deduplicate redacts matching lines to [REDACTED_UNTRUSTED_DIRECTIVE] and drops empty chunks.

nouns.title: Guardrail: packed context must never exceed token_budget
nouns.category_reason: Prevents silent context-window overflow and context rot.

value.rule: The sum of selected chunk token weights is strictly <= token_budget under exact 0/1 dynamic-programming knapsack.
value.how_it_is_checked: solve_01_knapsack enforces weight <= token_budget at every DP transition.

nouns.title: Guardrail: prune MinHash near-duplicates and discount overlapping coverage
nouns.category_reason: Prevents wasting context budget on repeated paraphrases of the same passage.

value.rule: Chunks with 64-permutation 3-shingle MinHash similarity >= 0.75 to a higher-ranked chunk are dropped, and remaining overlaps are discounted by redundancy_lambda.
value.how_it_is_checked: sanitize_and_deduplicate and pack_context_knapsack enforce both stages deterministically.

nouns.category_reason: Zero-call sanitization and near-duplicate filter over ranked chunks.

value.name: Hybrid retrieval context knapsack
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Computes Okapi BM25 and dense cosine similarity and fuses ranks with RRF (k=60).
Redacts untrusted prompt-injection lines and prunes 64-permutation MinHash near-duplicates.
Solves exact 0/1 dynamic-programming knapsack with marginal overlap penalties under a token budget.
does_not: Call external embedding APIs, fetch remote URLs or execute instructions found inside retrieved text.
